Good evening, and welcome to The Corner, a sports bar in Madrid. Tonight the big match starts at nine o'clock. There are four big screens, so every table has a good view. Do you want a table for you and your friends? Please talk to us at the bar. We don't take reservations after eight. Enjoy the game!

Hi, I'm Diego, and I live in Porto Alegre. I love football. I play every Tuesday night with my friends from work. I don't play very well, but I have a lot of fun. On weekends, I watch the matches at a bar near my house. I don't watch them at home, because I like the noise and the people. And you? Do you play football?

Camillo is in Madrid on a Saturday night. He goes to a sports bar to watch a big match. He sits next to Emma, an American woman. She asks: Do you like football? He says: Yes, I play every week with my friends. Then they watch the match together and talk about their weekends.
